title: Utillian 421 Dry Herb Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
The Utillian 421 dry herb vape device is a follow up to the best-selling budget vaporizer, the Utillian 420. The Utillian 421 improves upon its predecessor offering 6 temperature settings, bigger battery, and airflow control, all while maintaining the digital display and glass mouthpiece people loved from the previous model.
The Utillian 421 gives you a glass mouthpiece, digital display, airflow control and a large ceramic heating chamber packing value into this portable unit.
The Utillian 421’s display has been upgraded. The display now shows the set temperature of the device, as well as your charge level.
The
Utillian glass mouthpiece
is easy to clean and provides great vapor quality. The mouthpiece on the 421 screws into place to remain secure during use.
There is just one button on the 421 making it super simple to operate.
5 clicks turns the 421 on, then hold the power button until your desired vaping temperature shows up on the display. When the current temperature matches the selected temperature, you’re ready to vape. It’s as simple as that!
The 421 vaporizer provides you with 6 temperature settings; 180°C, 190°C, 200°C, 210°C, 220°C, 230°C giving you a large range to work with for vaporizing your herbs. The 421 gives you are larger range of temperatures than the 420 vaporizer offering a lower starting temperature for those who prefer flavor and a higher maximum temperature for those who prefer clouds.
Accessory Quick Links:
Utillian 421 Replacement Screens
Utillian 421 Replacement Mouthpiece
Dimensions: 11.8cm x 5cm
Battery: 2300mAh
Presets: 180, 190, 200, 210, 220, 230 C
Heating: Conduction
Heating Time: Approximately 1 minute
Charging: Micro USB (port in bottom)
Session Time: 7 minutes
Auto shut-off feature
Warranty: 1 year
1 x Utillian 421 Dry Herb Vape Device
1 x Packing Tool
5 x Spare Screens
1 x Mouthpiece Heaty Shield
1 x USB charging cable
